description.value: Once per day, with no action required, do one of the following: treat a natural 1 you just rolled on a check, attack roll, or saving throw as a natural 20 instead, or force an enemy within 60 feet who just rolled a natural 20 to treat it as a natural 10 instead. The house doesn't cheat. It just decides, once a day, which way the balance tips.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Treat your own just-rolled natural 1 as a natural 20, OR force an enemy's just-rolled natural 20 within 60 feet to be treated as a natural 10" is P-DIE for the self-facing clause (redefining a rolled die's value, not a reroll and not a degree-of-success shift; no rule element does this, confirmed absent via exhaustive grep this pass) and additionally P-CROSS for the enemy-facing clause (redefining a DIFFERENT creature's already-rolled die).
